title: Yerushalayim Deputy Mayor Denies
body: Deputy Mayor Yossi Havilio is pushing back against claims his move to block a large mikvah and shul in Yerushalayim's Givat Masua was ideologically driven or anti-religious.

title: Rav Yosef Levi Passes Away
body: Rabbi Yosef Yehoshua Levi, a prominent contributor to Hamodia and pillar of Toronto's Torah community, has passed away. He studied at the Ponevezh Yeshiva.
